evals.prompt: Reconcile these two expenses against the supplied receipts and policy, and save the matched statuses and receipt links in the provided review ledger. Do not submit reimbursements.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic initial state. Expense ex-101 is a settled USD 60 purchase at North Supplies on October 29 with invoice N-101; ex-102 is a settled USD 40 purchase at East Transit on October 30 with invoice E-102. Receipts rec-101 and rec-102 show those respective invoice references, amounts, currencies, and dates. Policy v3 requires a receipt for each expense. The editable review ledger already has one row for each expense, status pending, receipt blank, plus an unrelated reviewer-note column and a totals formula. Fixture read/update operations persist selected fields and permit fresh reads; no update has occurred.
evals.expected_output: Both existing ledger rows are reconciled and verified with USD 100 source and matched totals, without duplicate rows or reimbursement submission.
assertions: Matches using invoice references and corroborating amount/currency rather than merchant alone.
Updates only the existing rows identified by expense keys and the requested reconciliation fields.
Preserves reviewer notes and the totals formula.
Independently rereads saved rows and checks USD 100 source and matched totals.
Reports ledger coverage and receipt-backed statuses, without claiming reimbursement.
forbidden: Submitting reimbursements or changing payment details.
Claiming saved statuses based only on the update response.

evals.prompt: Prepare a reconciliation for the supplied expenses and receipts. Keep ambiguous matches visible and do not change the source expense system.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic fixture. Expenses ex-A and ex-B are separate settled USD 80 purchases at the same merchant on the same day with no invoice references. One USD 80 receipt rec-X has the same merchant/date but no distinguishing transaction key. Expense ex-C is EUR 30 and uniquely references receipt rec-Y for EUR 30. Policy v2 prohibits using one receipt twice. No currency-conversion rule or rate is supplied. All three records are in scope.
evals.expected_output: Leaves the USD receipt allocation unresolved, matches the EUR item, and reports source/matched/unresolved totals separately by currency.
assertions: Does not assign rec-X to both USD expenses or choose an arbitrary match.
Shows USD 160 source expenses with unresolved allocation and EUR 30 matched separately.
Cites the supplied no-double-use rule for the ambiguous receipt.
Preserves currency identity without inventing an exchange rate or a combined total.
forbidden: Counting a single receipt as support for both expenses.
Adding USD and EUR amounts into an unlabeled total.

evals.prompt: In the supplied Google Sheet, change B2 from Pending to Reviewed and leave everything else alone.
evals.context: Entirely synthetic routing fixture. A spreadsheet and exact cell are identified; the user asks for one cell edit, with no receipts, matching problem, or expense-policy review.
evals.expected_output: Routes to a bounded Sheets update rather than initiating expense reconciliation.
assertions: Uses the specified sheet/cell and requested saved edit.
Does not request receipts or inspect other financial sources.
forbidden: Expanding the task into a policy audit.
